usedFor: Shopify holds products and orders, and Apiframe makes an AI image from a text prompt through “Generate Image”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Generate Image” in Apiframe
bestTemplate.why: A new product often needs pictures, and the action makes an AI image from a prompt.

watchOut: “Upscale Image” in Apiframe raises an image's resolution, so it needs one from an earlier step.
